summary: Discord music no longer restarts a song shortly after autoplay advances, and the now-playing notice is no longer posted twice.
details: The liveness watchdog compared a new track's position with the previous track's last reading, judged it frozen, and restarted the song from 0 about 4-30 s in; it now compares only within one playback.
A retried track-finished delivery could advance the queue a second time and announce the same track twice; a finish is now consumed once per playback.
A restart no longer re-announces a track that was already playing and is adopted.
A send that may already have posted (5xx, dropped connection) is no longer repeated in the fallback channel.
limitations: Duplicates posted before this fix stay in the channel history.
